content.intro: M5: Energy Governance for a Just Energy Transition

content.text: This chapter provides a foundational understanding of energy governance and its critical role in ensuring a <ai prompt="Clarify just energy transition.">just energy transition 💬️</ai>. It explores governance principles, challenges, and frameworks necessary for navigating the global shift toward clean energy while addressing economic, social, and environmental inequalities.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Introduction to Energy Governance
lessons.description: This lesson defines governance and energy governance, emphasizing their critical role in shaping decision-making, managing trade-offs, and ensuring a just energy transition, and discusses the three principles of effectiveness, inclusinvess and accountability

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Political economy And Energy Governance
lessons.description: This lesson discusses the significance of policy coherence to align policies across sectors to prevent conflicts and maximize synergies, exploring key pillars‚Äîincluding institutional capacity, partnerships, data analysis, and coordination mechanisms‚Äîthat enhance effective governance for sustainable energy transitions.
